name: New Zealand
study_positioning: Destination for tertiary, vocational, school, and English-language study with work rights depending on visa conditions.

fee.name: Fee Paying Student Visa
fee.note: From amount shown by Immigration New Zealand

process: Get an offer of place from approved education provider
Prepare tuition payment evidence or ability to pay
Prepare living funds, insurance, passport, health/character documents if required
visa.deadlines: International students are strongly encouraged to apply 3 months before intended travel.
funds: NZD 20000 per year for tertiary/English/non-compulsory study of 1 year or more
NZD 1667 per month for shorter tertiary/English/non-compulsory study
visa.work_rights: May work up to 25 hours per week while studying and full-time in holidays, depending on visa conditions.
